title: Pilobol.us P3-14: retire Git content as source of truth, remove Pilobol.us from Papyrus core, rewrite docs and procedures
description:
## Goal
Retire the Git content as source of truth after a clean soak, finish removing Pilobol.us from the Papyrus repo, and update every doc and procedure so the desk publishes through the CMS.

## Context (FACT)
- Pilobol.us content is Git-authored today; AGENTS.md says reader content is committed under web/content/articles and "production is deployed through DevOps". Overnight automation is board-only (never publishes).
- Leftovers: root amplify.yml (already removed), the PAT secret amplify/github-app-token in Secrets Manager (it is the rollback for the CMS repo connection: delete only after the soak), the reader app env var NAME ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (legacy; Auritus replaced it; never print the value), Papyrus publications/pilobol_us and publications/pilobolus, the brand entry in repo-root papyrus.config.ts of Papyrus, PILOBOL_US_THEME_PACK_TOKENS in lib/site-stack.ts, publications/pilobol_us/docs/bootstrap.md, docs/site-hosting.md "Split reader + CMS" section, /Users/home/Projects/Pilobolus/site.yml (cms.repo and cms.branch fields still point at AnthusAI/Papyrus).
- Only one app-shell stack exists in the account (amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us), so the PAT secret has no other user to check; confirm with a search of other stacks before deleting.
- The 3 drafts (and all of web/content) are public in the Git history; they cannot be un-published from history without a rewrite: do not rewrite history.

## Exact steps
1. Pilobol.us PR: move reader-owned files (JS, CSS, HTML, unreferenced images) from web/content/assets to web/reader-assets and update reader/build.py's overlay path; git rm the Git content (articles, drafts, effects, a-fungus-among-us.md, imported images); remove the Git branch of the build spec and the Papyrus clone/PAPYRUS_PIN code; keep tag pre-cms-cutover as the rollback reference. Parity harness after merge: 94/94.
2. Rewrite AGENTS.md (Deployment: CMS + packages, no DevOps zip; Build: reader/build.py; Publishing: human Publish in /newsroom or papyrus content publish; automation stays board-only) and README.md; replace project/wiki or skills text that tells agents to commit to web/content/articles (skills/advance-story and skills/publication-writing: the published stage = CMS publish).
3. Papyrus PR (develop): delete publications/pilobol_us and publications/pilobolus (editorial files already copied by the scaffold), remove the pilobolUsBrand import from papyrus.config.ts, remove PILOBOL_US_THEME_PACK_TOKENS and the pilobol-us entries that the brand registry no longer needs (keep tests green), update docs/site-hosting.md and docs/standard-site.md 3.3 to "migrated", and replace publications/pilobol_us/docs/bootstrap.md with a pointer to docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (final state).
4. Update /Users/home/Projects/Pilobolus/site.yml (reader repo, cms.repo AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, drop the cursor branch) outside git (local file; Ryan's tree).
5. Ryan yes: delete Secrets Manager secret amplify/github-app-token (recovery window, not force) after confirming the connection is the GitHub App on both apps; remove the app env var ELEVENLABS_API_KEY from the reader app if unused (confirm with Ryan: legacy key for the old narration path).
6. Close the Pilobol.us part of Phase 3 on PPY-3367d3 with a summary.

## Acceptance checks
- Reader build from the CMS only (no Git content): verify-parity.py 94/94 vs the previous live; npm/pip pins current; Papyrus CI green; a grep for pilobol in Papyrus src and lib returns no brand-specific logic outside tests and docs.

## Rollback
Git revert of the PRs (content is still in history and the tag). The PAT secret is restorable within its recovery window.

## Risks
- Removing Git content removes the Git rollback path: only after the soak and a snapshot export committed to a branch.
- Papyrus demo code still mentions Pilobolus (lib/category-repository.ts demo labels, lib/pilobol-sample.ts): out of scope, harmless.

## Needs Ryan
Merge approvals; the secret deletion; ELEVENLABS decision.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 3 Pilobol.us ticket)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (AnthusAI/Papyrus, PR from branch docs/PPY-3367d3-pilobol-us-migration-plan). Facts there were verified 2026-10-06; marked FACT or ASSUMPTION. Re-verify anything you depend on before acting.
- LIVE steps (marked LIVE) touch production resources (apps d1od6t7lzbwanr and d11eu9hbs2mipk, their branches, domains, stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, the CMS backend). Do them ONLY after Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Everything else is read-only AWS (list/get/describe) or scratch work.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, region us-east-1 (SSO login is Ryan's). Never print an env var or secret VALUE (names only; the apps hold secrets in env vars and SSM). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally (Amplify builds do that).
- The local checkout /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us is read-only for us, and its build REWRITES content front matter and generated files: never build there. Build only in scratch copies of a fresh clone (git clone https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, or git archive origin/main).
- Papyrus repo work: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug> (or chore/ for docs), PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, conventional commits, commit trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo work: a feature branch and a PR; never push or merge to its main (production reader deploys from main). In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus run only kbs; never git add or commit there. Tickets live on the PPY board; do not use kbs in the Pilobol.us repo (PILO board is stories only).
- Keep article text byte-identical everywhere. Narration (Auritus) hashes cover article text: any text change re-queues Batch jobs.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link, command output and numbers when done.
